description:
Step 2 of authentication. Exchanges a signed SIWE/SIWS message for a session bound to a backend JWT. Call get_auth_nonce first and embed the nonce in the message.

Params: wallet_address (string), chain_type ('evm'|'solana'), signed_message (string), signature (string)
Returns: {session_token: string, expires_at: string}
Errors: INVALID_SIGNATURE, INVALID_ADDRESS, UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN, JWT_EXCHANGE_FAILED

signature.description: The signature of the message (hex for EVM, base58 for Solana)

signed_message.description: The SIWE or SIWS message that was signed. Must include the server-issued nonce from get_auth_nonce.

wallet_address.description: Wallet address (0x... for EVM, base58 for Solana)

name: authenticate
title: Sign in with a wallet signature
